details.description: General 'what is it like to live there' explanation
details.response_text: Koramangala is a vibrant, youthful hub known as the startup center of Bengaluru. It offers a mix of lively commercial areas with plenty of cafes and nightlife, alongside quieter residential blocks. It is popular with young professionals and students, and is generally considered a safe, well-connected neighborhood.

claims.claim: known as the startup center of Bengaluru
claims.supporting_quote: It is often called the "startup hub" of Bengaluru

claims.claim: offers a mix of lively commercial areas with plenty of cafes and nightlife
claims.supporting_quote: The 5th and 6th Blocks are the commercial heart, lined with restaurants, cafes, boutique shops, and pubs. ... Koramangala has one of the most active nightlife scenes in Bengaluru: Numerous pubs, bars, and microbreweries concentrated in 5th Block and along 80 Feet Road

claims.claim: popular with young professionals and students
claims.supporting_quote: The area has a cosmopolitan feel with a diverse mix of young professionals, entrepreneurs, students (IIM Bangalore is located here), and established families.

details.description: Safety question — claims must come from the Safety section
details.response_text: HSR Layout is widely considered one of the safest neighborhoods in Bengaluru. It has well-lit main roads, active resident associations, and a strong sense of community, making it very safe for evening walks. The only minor note is that some residents have mentioned stray dogs in park areas at night.
